items.name: MergeSE
items.description: Open-source CLI and web tool for training-free merging of Hugging Face encoder checkpoints, with inspect, merge, evaluate and export steps for software engineering classification tasks.

items.name: GPTCloneBench
items.description: Benchmark of 37,149 true semantic clone pairs, 19,288 false semantic pairs and 20,770 cross-language clone pairs in Java, C, C# and Python, built from SemanticCloneBench and GPT-3.
